summary: The standard high-end deck since 9/20. Five cookies sit at Lv.1 so Pomegranate's +69% skill-amp beams land only on the carries, and Cherry pulls the team into a straight line so Macaron's crit-rate buff reaches Brightseeker.

cookies.why: ATK #1 on purpose. The 열정페이 (+20% ATK) and 초고속승진 (+7% ATK) perks go to the highest-ATK ally, and Milk's own ATK buff scales with her ATK, so every point she gains is shared with the team. She's also always inside Pomegranate's beam set. Sugar runes are all ATK%, and 10★ matters.

cookies.level_rule: Lv.100, or as high as possible while ATK < Milk
cookies.why: The damage carry (one poster puts her above 90% of team damage) and a Light attacker against a Dark boss. She has to be ATK #2 so she's always in Pomegranate's beams. Stars matter a lot: posters measured +25–47% going 4★ → 5★ (5★ adds a drone), and one estimates about 1000× at 10★.

cookies.level_rule: As high as possible while ATK < Milk (usually ATK #3)
cookies.why: Skill-amp buffer with high base ATK, so she ranks into Pomegranate's beams without any ATK runes and every rune line goes to skill amp.
Hands out 300%+ crit rate, but only to cookies lined up with her. That's why Cherry is in the deck. ATK #4 (or #3 if you gave her ATK runes, which the guides now say to reroll to skill amp).

cookies.level_rule: Lv.100, or tuned to Lv.89–98 to sit just under Cheesecake
cookies.why: Her buff only works in Guild Conquest. She stands at the front and often misses Milk's buff, so her ATK rank flickers. Some top posters trim her level so she reliably sits 6th and a misfired beam still lands on a skill-amp user.

Her ATK buff lands on Milk, which raises Milk's buff for everyone, and her skill grants 다발 2, which takes Pomegranate from 3 beams to 5. When Pomegranate holds Tiger Lily's 다발 3 instead, she fires six, and Cheesecake is the sixth recipient. Levelling her down lets Pinot or Dark Choco, who get nothing from skill amp, steal that beam. Runes are all skill amp.

cookies.level_rule: Lv.1 or Lv.100: no damage difference
cookies.why: The buffer. Her +69% skill-amp beams don't scale with her level or ATK, and she never targets herself. Lv.1 only lowers team power, which inflates the damage ÷ power multiple (the #1 1T 312G run does this). She survives to the 17 s wipe either way. Runes are all skill amp.

cookies.level_rule: Lv.1–45, keeping ATK ≥10% below the 6th cookie after Octo Wasabi's +8%
cookies.why: A backstop, not a carry. When Tea Knight misses Milk's buff, a beam goes stray, and a few levels on Scorpion make it land on her (she uses skill amp) instead of Dark Choco (who doesn't). Octo Wasabi adds +8% ATK when she enters, so check the order in battle, not in the lobby.

Kept Lv.1 so she never takes a beam. She's there for the 다발 3 her mount grants to nearby allies: Pomegranate holding it fires 6 beams instead of the 5 from Cheesecake's 다발 2. Pomegranate has to be near her when she mounts, so skill-haste runes let her mount before Pomegranate's second cast. If the team wipes at the 30 s slam, swap her for Herb (+2).

Brings a DEF-shred debuff. Skill amp doesn't boost that since the 8/27 patch, so her runes go to skill haste. Even at Lv.1 her ATK is high enough to steal a stray beam, which is why Scorpion is kept slightly higher.
Formation only. Her presence makes the team charge in a straight line, which puts Brightseeker (and Scorpion) inside Macaron's crit-rate buff. No investment needed.

Gives allies +35% lift resistance. The boss's launches cancel any skill if the cookie is airborne 0.4 s or longer, and Pinot plus a lift-resistance pet (64% total) keeps launches under that. Needs no ATK, so Lv.1.

atk_order_note: Order by 공격력 (ATK), not 전투력 (power). Pomegranate is outside the order. If Macaron still has ATK runes it becomes Milk › Brightseeker › Macaron › Skating Queen › Tea Knight › Cheesecake.
perks: Leader Milk. 복지 (welfare): 열정페이 + 초고속승진, both landing on Milk. Mercenary squad Lv.4 for the second welfare slot and the third pet slot.
formation: No move speed on any rune or gear piece. Cherry does the aligning; any move speed breaks it.
substitutions: Tiger Lily → Herb if the team dies at the 30 s slam. Herb gives 5 beams instead of 6, so Tea Knight drops to Lv.1 and only ranks 1–5 get buffed.
Cherry → Melon Soda if you're willing to tune move speed to 0.01 precision (see the Melon Soda deck).
Candy Shade Pouch replaced Panda Dumpling after 9/23 (more lift resistance plus 12.5% HP).
rng: At 1.74G power, 1T lands in 1–2 of 10 runs and 1.1T occasionally. At 0.97G the author reports a 150× floor, a 250–350× average and a 400×+ peak. Ten minutes of hand play gives about 300–350×; the 400× record took 14 hours of overnight macro retries.
unorthodox: Five cookies at Lv.1, including the damage-dealer Scorpion in some versions and the buffer Pomegranate in the #1 run.
An R-rarity Cherry Cookie in an endgame team, purely for formation.
Scorpion levelled to a precise ATK window as a beam catcher rather than as a dealer.

summary: Replaces Cherry with Melon Soda and aligns the team through move speed on sugar runes. Higher peak per power than Cherry when the line forms, but the tuning is per-account and unforgiving.

cookies.why: Same as in the Cherry deck: ATK #1 for the perks, and her buff scales with her ATK.
The carry. One move-speed rune line (0.32 on the source account) so she arrives in line. 0.20, 0.26 and 0.29 all failed.

Crit-rate buffer. Everything else exists to put Brightseeker inside her buff.

Sixth beam recipient; buffs Milk's ATK.

Placement cookie. Move speed 0.51 + 0.20 on sugar runes (later −0.03, which improved alignment). Kept low so she never takes a beam.
Lift resistance plus 1–2 move-speed rune lines (0.26 + 0.57 on the source account) to control arrival order.
The level is a fine ATK knob: raised just enough that a stray beam lands on her rather than on Melon Soda.
Multi-hit synergy for 6 beams. All skill-haste runes, and no move speed.
DEF shred. Level tuned so her ATK stays under the beam recipients.

formation: Move speed only from sugar runes, on Brightseeker, Pinot and Melon Soda. None on gear. The target is a single line (일렬).
substitutions: Panda Dumpling is still used here instead of Candy Shade Pouch, because the pet's lift resistance changes placement and the speed values were tuned with Panda.
Lazy variant: Tiger Lily in Herb's slot with speed only on Pinot and Melon Soda. It aligns well but breaks the multi-hit chain, so damage is lower.
rng: The source player gets a good alignment in about 3 of 4 runs. A 0.03 speed difference can stop the line forming at all. The same setup aligned on one device and not on another (Galaxy vs Lenovo tablet).
unorthodox: Move speed tuned to hundredths on sugar runes to script where each cookie stops.
A 5★ Brightseeker reached 637.8G at 1.14G power, higher per power than most 10★ Cherry decks at the time.
